verdict.rationale: The NVIDIA H200 SXM is a data-center GPU, a hardware accelerator, not a hosted service that holds a user's account data. Exporting all of your data in open formats and leaving is therefore a category error for this product type. Nothing in the evidence shows the product offers any data-export capability that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
